channel.restore: retained runtime: noise_power_dB -50 commanded, read back and verified at teardown

schedule.actor_observation: the retained causal SNR proxy is the ACKed COMMANDED TARGET (controller publication), constant 21.5 dB -> feature 22 = (21.5-5.5)/19 = 0.842105...; it is not a measured achieved SNR; schedule identity/step/route progress never enter the actor state
schedule.continuation: CONSTANT (same value every 100-ms step after the prefix)
schedule.hold_semantics: constant by design; the config's forbidden_after_prefix (wrap/hold_final_value/reseed) governs the Gaussian-Markov traces and is not violated: no stochastic trace is replayed
schedule.not_the_stochastic_profile: FAVORABLE_STABLE is a Gaussian-Markov trace (profile mean ~20.0 dB); GOOD_ALL is a new deterministic constant schedule and is reported under its own name

channel.seam: UE child sets splitfusion_run5_full_live_v1.runtime_policy.CONTROLLER_MODULE; the controller replaces only ue_target_snr_cell_runtime_v1.prepare_sequence and rewrites --profile-id to GOOD_ALL

map_class.scope: every Run-4 map update installed (policy decisions, holds, fallbacks) in the map process only
map_class.seam: seams_ue_v1.MAP_SERVER -> m3v3_map_profiled_v1.py (sampler/marker substring map_profiled_v1.py kept), which wraps phase6_map_server_v2.install to convert on a copy before the frozen install
map_class.unchanged: object count, order, scores, coordinates, all other fields; edge records, scorer inputs, hashes, confidence thresholds and filtering
map_class.unknown_class: left without type (baseline -> Unknown) and counted

route.cadence: 20 Hz world ticks (fixed_delta 0.05 s, real-time paced), one prepared frame per 2 ticks

completion.final_cycle_exception: P3_HOLD_TICKET admits exactly one single-frame decision group iff it is the last decision of the last session, its frame is the last transmitted frame and it is reward-requested (the loop can end between a decision and its hold); every other group needs >= 2 frames
completion.incomplete: FRAME_CEILING reached, SAFETY_TIMEOUT_EXPIRED, route watchdog/abort, missing/mismatched route summary, collector failure: INCOMPLETE_ROUTE (evidence kept, never a pass, no retry)

progress_evidence.source: UE pose archive ego_world per transmitted frame (scientific, measured pose)

runner_criteria.route_outcome: classification in the retained ue_route_b_split_cell_adapter_v1.ROUTE_ACCEPTABLE_OUTCOMES (PASS; INTERVENED with permitted roadblock clearing; proven collision-only; proven no-pedestrian-braking) -- the run_route_b 'accepted' result, unchanged

completion.terminal: ROUTE_COMPLETED: run_route_b returned accepted with route_completed, the durable route summary persisted with matching identity, and the collector made no early stop (no frame-ceiling / safety-timeout / decision-cycle stop)

route.derivation: full loops 298.75-309.2 s simulated (2,990-3,060 frames; 14 direct-edge-map loops), slowest observed 361.5 s (~3,615 frames, 288 campaign); ceiling 3,900 frames; watchdog 900 s
route.route_name: Town10HD_Opt Route B full-map loop v1
